k-a-h-game-monitor.name: K.A.H. Game Monitor
k-a-h-game-monitor.description:
The Kinemantik At Home (K.A.H.)<RETRO_TM> Game Monitor is the best way to run your K.A.H. system at home with perfect 64-bit definition. 

(Note: The K.A.H. Game System is only compatible with the K.A.H. Game Monitor and will not work with any other TV or monitor.)

k-a-h-game-system.name: K.A.H. Game System
k-a-h-game-system.description: The Kinemantik At Home (K.A.H.)<RETRO_TM> Game System is a new revolutionary way to bring the arcade to your living room!

kappa-beacon.name: Kappa Beacon
kappa-beacon.description: Locator beacon broadcasting on the kappa frequency

karkina-antenna.name: Karkina Antenna
karkina-antenna.description:
Ground into a powder this substance can makes fires burn hotter for a brief amount of time.

Source: Cut from Karkina fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Karkina in the Plains of Eidolon ocean at any time of day using Twilight Bait. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

kavat-genetic-code.name: Kavat Genetic Code
kavat-genetic-code.description:
Contains the genetic code sequence of a Kavat. 

Location: Obtained by using a Codex Scanner on Feral Kavats that roam the Orokin Derelict on Deimos

kavat-incubator-upgrade-segment.name: Kavat Incubator Upgrade Segment
kavat-incubator-upgrade-segment.description: Allows the Incubator to breed Kavats.

khora-prime-theme.name: Khora Prime Theme
khora-prime-theme.description: Khora Prime's signature theme music to enjoy from the Somachord in your Orbiter.

khut-khut-venom-sac.name: Khut-Khut Venom Sac
khut-khut-venom-sac.description:
The poison is used to cure leather and as a reagent to produce an embalming fluid.

Source: Cut from Khut-Khut fish via Fisher Hai-Luk in Cetus (Earth). Catch Khut-Khut in Plains of Eidolon ponds during the Day. Also drops from Thumpers in the Plains of Eidolon.

kick-out-the-guns.name: Kick Out The Guns
kick-out-the-guns.description: Caliber Chicks 2 Original Soundtrack to enjoy from the Somachord in your Orbiter.

kinebasik-assorted-roadsigns.description: For all your KineBasik<Retro_TM> Assorted Roadsign Needs!

kinebasik-asst-metal-keychains.description: This assorted collection of KineBasik<RETRO_TM> metal keychains comes in a case of 100 and is sure to meet your needs!

kinebasik-hanging-planter.name: Kinebasik Hanging Planter
kinebasik-hanging-planter.description: For all your KineBasik<RETRO_TM> plant-hanging needs! Bring a little bit of nature inside.

kinebasik-medical-kit.name: Kinebasik Medical Kit
kinebasik-medical-kit.description: For all your KineBasik<RETRO_TM> emergency medical needs!

kinebasik-metal-lunch-box.name: Kinebasik Metal Lunch Box
kinebasik-metal-lunch-box.description: For all your KineBasik<RETRO_TM> lunch carrying needs!

kinebasik-paper-party-hats.name: Kinebasik Paper Party Hats
kinebasik-paper-party-hats.description: For all your KineBasik<RETRO_TM> Party needs!

kinebasik-pillows.name: Kinebasik Pillows
kinebasik-pillows.description: For all your KineBasik<RETRO_TM> pillow needs!

kinebasik-pizza-boxes.name: Kinebasik Pizza Boxes
kinebasik-pizza-boxes.description: For all your KineBasik<RETRO_TM> pizza boxing needs! (Note: Pizza not included.)

kinekitchen-coffee-machine.name: Kinekitchen Coffee Machine
kinekitchen-coffee-machine.description: The KineKitchen<RETRO_TM> line of coffee makers has the new, patent pending 'sneak a cup' feature that allows you to fill your cup while the machine is brewing!

kinekitchen-microwave.name: Kinekitchen Microwave
kinekitchen-microwave.description: The KineKitchen<RETRO_TM> Microwave comes with brand-new patent-pending settings like SmartDefrost and Insta-Pop! Make popcorn in ten seconds or less with no burnt kernels - guaranteed!

kinekitchen-toaster.name: Kinekitchen Toaster
kinekitchen-toaster.description: The KineKitchen<RETRO_TM> toaster comes with four sets of electrical coils and ten heat settings for that perfect crispy breakfast!

kinekitchen-toaster-oven.name: Kinekitchen Toaster Oven
kinekitchen-toaster-oven.description: The KineKitchen<RETRO_TM> Toaster Oven is perfect for those smaller kitchens or cooking on the go, where a full kitchen isn't available. It's amazing what you can make with it's broil and convection settings!

kinemagik-boom-box.name: Kinemagik! Boom Box
kinemagik-boom-box.description: The KineMagik!<RETRO_TM> Boom Box is for when you want to make sure that the entire neighborhood shares in your tunes!

kinemagik-party-light.name: Kinemagik! Party Light
kinemagik-party-light.description: This KineMagik!<RETRO_TM> kicking party light also doubles as a search light in instances of duress!

kinemagik-portable-tv.name: Kinemagik! Portable Tv
kinemagik-portable-tv.description: Take your shows on the road with this KineMagik!<RETRO_TM> portable TV with included tuner!

kinemagik-wireless-headphones.name: Kinemagik! Wireless Headphones
kinemagik-wireless-headphones.description:
Imagine the freedom you'll have with these KineMagik!<RETRO_TM> Wireless Headphones! Includes a 2 channel transmitter that works up to 100m*!

(*Within direct line of sight. Batteries not included.)

kinemantik-256-gpu.name: Kinemantik 256 Gpu
kinemantik-256-gpu.description: HOT NEW RELEASE!! This WORLD FIRST Graphics Processing Unit will change gaming as you know it! With an 128-bit onboard memory interface and both VHS and Composite outputs, the Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> 256 GPU will NEVER go obsolete!

kinemantik-840hd-tv.name: Kinemantik 840hd Tv
kinemantik-840hd-tv.description: The Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> 840 HD TV is the top-of-the-line cathode-ray tube television set, showing all your favorite programs in their beautiful 4:3 aspect ratio!

kinemantik-a-v-receiver.name: Kinemantik A/V Receiver
kinemantik-a-v-receiver.description: UPGRADED with TWO Video Inputs and THREE Audio Inputs!

kinemantik-announce.name: Kinemantik Announce
kinemantik-announce.description: The Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> Announce is compatible with all major systems. With an adjustable in-line volume override, it is sure to muster even the most stubborn of troops.

kinemantik-cellphone.name: Kinemantik Cellphone
kinemantik-cellphone.description:
Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> Cellphones are guaranteed* to be indestructible for life!

(*By purchasing any Kinemantik product, including subscriptions to Kinemantik On Line, the purchaser waives all rights to pursue claims, legal remedies, or damages against Kinemantik, its affiliates, or successors, to the fullest extent permitted by law.)

kinemantik-digital-phone.name: Kinemantik Digital Phone
kinemantik-digital-phone.description: Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> Digital Phones are guaranteed to have service absolutely everywhere!

kinemantik-digital-video-camera.name: Kinemantik Digital Video Camera
kinemantik-digital-video-camera.description: Take the show on the road with this amazing Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> DIGITAL Video Camera! Welcome to the future with the world of digital video recording! With an attached polycrystalline-silicon LCD monitor, you'll be the talk of the neighborhood!

kinemantik-hockey-table.name: Kinemantik Hockey Table
kinemantik-hockey-table.description: Enjoy the very best of Air Hockey with this Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> Air Hockey Table!

kinemantik-speaker.name: Kinemantik Speaker
kinemantik-speaker.description: This Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> single speaker operates at 500w! Requires a Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> A/V Receiver or other amp to function.

kinemantik-speaker-system.name: Kinemantik Speaker System
kinemantik-speaker-system.description: This Kinemantik<RETRO_TM> Speaker System with Amp is the all-in-one solution for anyone who wants to listen to their favorite tunes at full volume! Compatible with all KineMagik!<RETRO_TM> headphones.

kriller-thermal-laser.name: Kriller Thermal Laser
kriller-thermal-laser.description:
A weapon that discharges lasers over short distances.

Source: Dismantled from Kriller servofish via The Business in Fortuna (Venus). Catch Kriller in the Orb Vallis lake during Warm weather. Also drops from resource containers across the Orb Vallis.

kubrodon-incarnadine-tag.name: Kubrodon Incarnadine Tag
kubrodon-incarnadine-tag.description: For saving a specimen of this subspecies.

kubrow-egg.name: Kubrow Egg
kubrow-egg.description:
This egg is used to transplant the genetic code of a Kubrow onto a Kubrow clone.

Location: Kubrow Dens found in Grineer Forests on Earth

kullervo-s-hold-scene.name: Kullervo's Hold Scene
kullervo-s-hold-scene.description: Unlocks this scene for use in Captura Mode, accessed through the Warframe Appearance tab in the Arsenal.

kunai-incarnon-genesis.name: Kunai Incarnon Genesis
kunai-incarnon-genesis.description: Awaken this weapon's ability to seek Headshots and increase Multishot in Incarnon Form.

kuva-fortress-crevice-scene.description: Unlocks this scene for use in Captura Mode, accessed through the Warframe Appearance tab in the Arsenal.
